query:
SELECT d.id, d.version, d.coprocessor_context_id, d.host_chain_id,
                  d.handle, d.block_number, d.block_hash,
                  d.consensus_epoch = $1 AS "local!"
             FROM public.drifted_handle d
            WHERE d.id = ANY($2) AND d.reason = 'ct64_mismatch' AND d.healed_at IS NULL
              AND (
                    d.consensus_epoch = $1
                    OR (
                        NOT EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1 FROM public.drifted_handle cur
                             WHERE cur.consensus_epoch = $1
                               AND cur.host_chain_id = d.host_chain_id
                               AND cur.handle = d.handle
                               AND cur.reason = 'ct64_mismatch'
                        )
                        AND (
                            (
                                NOT EXISTS (
                                    SELECT 1 FROM ciphertexts ct
                                     WHERE ct.handle = d.handle
                                       AND octet_length(ct.ciphertext) > 0
                                )
                                AND EXISTS (
                                    SELECT 1 FROM computations c
                                     WHERE c.host_chain_id = d.host_chain_id
                                       AND c.dependencies @> ARRAY[d.handle]::bytea[]
                                )
                            )
                            OR (
                                d.local_ct64_digest IS NOT NULL
                                AND EXISTS (
                                    SELECT 1 FROM ciphertext_digest cd
                                     WHERE cd.handle = d.handle
                                       AND cd.ciphertext = d.local_ct64_digest
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    )
              )
            ORDER BY d.id
